vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species pan_troglodytes --assembly Pan_tro_3.0 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (21, MT and the unplaced scaffold AACZ04007423.1) at their full length from Pan_troglodytes.Pan_tro_3.0.dna.chromosome.21.fa.gz, Pan_troglodytes.Pan_tro_3.0.dna.chromosome.MT.fa.gz and Pan_troglodytes.Pan_tro_3.0.dna.nonchromosomal.fa.gz of Ensembl release 116, each file held to the sum its directory's CHECKSUMS lists, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 338 records, every one generated from the converted cache and the genome sequence by tools/vep-seeded-variants with seed 1, its ID naming its category and ordinal (28 categories: code1_start_codon, code1_stop_gained, code1_stop_lost, code2_changed_codon, code2_start_codon, code2_stop_gained, code2_stop_lost, downstream, first_base, first_sequence, five_prime_utr, frameshift_deletion, frameshift_insertion, inframe_deletion, intergenic, intron, last_base, last_sequence, missense_forward, missense_reverse, organelle, splice_acceptor, splice_donor, synonym, synonymous_forward, synonymous_reverse, three_prime_utr, upstream). 256 are written under the name 21, 4 are written under the name AACZ04007423.1, 15 are written under the name CM004190.1, 49 are written under the name MT, 14 are written under the name NC_006488.4; NC_006488.4 and CM004190.1 are synonyms of chromosome 21 in the cache's chr_synonyms.txt. The cache marks no sequence circular, so the generator writes no record across an origin, and the cache's variation files hold no record, so the corpus carries no known variant

generator: tools/vep-seeded-variants --cache <converted cache> --seed 1 --records wide --per-category 150 --fasta <genome FASTA> --sequence MT --sequence 21 --sequence AACZ04007423.1 (generator version 2); Ensembl VEP over the generated records under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly Pan_tro_3.0 --species pan_troglodytes --dataset wide=<reference>=<the generated records> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, missense_variant, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_gained, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, synonymous_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <the named records> --covers species-chimpanzee-pantro3 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --flank 5000 --gzip --drop sorted_exons --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 --species pan_troglodytes --assembly Pan_tro_3.0 --variations <converted cache>/variations over the whole cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 Pan_tro_3.0 cache; scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <genome FASTA> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000 over the records with every sequence under the cache's own name; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs); scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp for the hgvs set)
